notes.title: January 2025 Update
notes.notes:
3 new levels playable:
Kokorro Gardens and Pachinko Parlor
Neptune's Bath Martini Club
Tiki Pirate Level (80 percent complete. Level name is still being decided.)

All made levels are accessible to try in the build. You don't have to currently beat other levels to unlock. Select Trial at the menu to go to the level select. I hope you all enjoy the new build!

notes.title: August 2024 Update: New Level! Kokoro Gardens and Pachinko Parlor!
notes.notes:
Early Access version now has the Kokoro Garden and Pachinko Parlor level. The main level design is done but we still working on enemy animations for the level but otherwise it's about 80% complete.

Early Access Version now has a level select so now players don't have to start from the beginning every time the game loads up. In the future we will have a save mode and a more developed level select and and adventure mode but hopefully this will work alright for the time being.

Other than that, we've been slowly but surely working on the next level: Neptune's Bath. It's an Underwater Martini Bar based off of Art Nouveau and submarines.

Some of the amazing WIP game design in this level:

[previewyoutube=pdXaggX7kY0;full][/previewyoutube]



Please try out the new build and we look forward to feedback!

notes.title: June Update
notes.notes:
Note: This is my first time doing an update on steam so let me know if there are any problems getting it to work.

Fixes/Changes:

* fixed bug where pressing tab by a word balloon would allow the player to edit the text.
* Added new lock-on ability. Press R3 or the Q button to lock on to the closest enemy on screen. The camera will follow that enemy. Press right thumbstick left or right to scroll between other enemies that are on the screen or in range (This mechanic is still a work in progress so feedback would be appreciated).

New level available:  Sassy Saloon!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44829980/b8859911a5ac095bd12009f5ccad9cbbca9258a1.png[/img]

It's the new second level in the game. Take a trip back to the past with Sassy Saloon! Its extensive mines in the mountains surrounding Starlight City have allowed it to operate independently for years. Come visit, take in the sunset and enjoy the ice cream! (note: cutscenes for level are not complete yet but everything else is good to go.)


For these early access releases, I'm thinking of making it so the player doesn't have to beat levels in order and can play any level they want since I haven't made a saving system yet. Please feel free to comment and let me know for future early access releases.

I'm hoping to have Kokorro Gardens level done by next month!

Peace out!
